verdict.rationale: Pipedrive publishes its own API Reference at developers.pipedrive.com, with per-endpoint listings and token costs, plus OpenAPI 3 specs for v1 and v2. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive or offers runnable examples; importing the OpenAPI spec into another tool is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser 'try it' console, runnable code examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can view the token costs for each API endpoint in our API Reference.
